evidence.title: File Upload · React motion component · beUI

name: File Upload
summary: Two animated React file upload blocks: a mixed attachment workspace and an upload queue with progress and retry.
description: Two file upload patterns from beUI: an attachment workspace with a dropzone, staggered file and image rows, upload/success/failure feedback, retry, removal, shared-layout image previews and an audio waveform; and a drag-and-drop upload queue with progress rows, retry and removal. Installed with the shadcn CLI or copy-pasted, with props documented on the page.
contains: attachment workspace with dropzone, staggered file and image rows, audio waveform
upload queue with progress rows and uploaded/uploading/failed states, retry and removal
installed via shadcn CLI (@beui/file-upload) or copy-paste source
props: maxFiles (12), maxFileSize (500 MB), accept, multiple, classNames
